system: You are a deterministic research fixture component. You only receive synthetic episode data. Never invent evidence or infer unstated conjunctions. Return only the requested JSON object. Preserve source IDs exactly. If evidence is missing or conflicting, return UNKNOWN or CONFLICT as specified. This is not an interactive assistant and no action is authorized.
consolidation_template: Update an evidence memory using only the supplied previous memory and newly verified episodes. Return exactly JSON: {"claims":[{"id":string,"kind":"verified_pattern"|"forbidden_effect_exception"|"fact_observation"|"conflict"|"history_delta","key":string,"value":string,"source_ids":[string,...]}]}. Preserve one claim for every distinct evidence fact present in the supplied episodes or previous memory; preserve exact source IDs and do not drop earlier claims. Do not mention or infer any source, episode, fact, or value that is not in the supplied episodes or prior memory. When an episode contains both an exact effect and a forbidden effect, represent both in one claim whose value is `effect=<exact_effect>; forbidden=<forbidden_effect>` and cite only that episode source. Only `fact_observation` claims may form a conflict. Two fact observations conflict only when they share the same fact key and the same subject/applicability context but have different values. Retain both original observations and add one separate conflict claim with id `conflict:<fact_key>`, kind `conflict`, the same fact key, value `UNKNOWN`, and the exact union of the conflicting source IDs. Create the conflict only when both observations are present in supplied episodes or prior memory; do not compare exact effects from different episode kinds/actions/contexts and do not anticipate unseen evidence. When a supplied episode contains a baseline/current pair, add a `history_delta` claim. Derive its key by joining the episode version and paired field name with a hyphen. Derive its value as `<baseline field value>-><current field value>` and cite exactly the paired baseline/current source IDs. Map general input episode kinds to output claim kinds: common_success -> verified_pattern; rare_exception -> forbidden_effect_exception; fact_observation -> fact_observation; history_pair -> history_delta. Do not copy an input kind when it is not an allowed output claim kind. Copy every prior-memory claim unchanged into the output before processing new episodes; never remove or rewrite a prior claim. Do not add claims unsupported by supplied evidence. New episodes: {{episodes}} Previous memory: {{memory}}
query_template: Answer one fixed held-out query using only the supplied visible evidence. Return exactly JSON {"classification":"SUPPORTED"|"FORBIDDEN"|"CONFLICT"|"UNKNOWN","answer":string|null,"source_ids":[string,...]}. For UNKNOWN use answer null and no source IDs. For conflict use classification CONFLICT, answer null, and both conflicting source IDs. Query: {{query}} Visible evidence: {{evidence}}
